# markdown

`MarkdownView` renders a Markdown file (frontmatter as a card, then the body).
Its reading inset is the density group's `documentPadTop` / `documentPadX` /
`documentPadBottom` tokens (defaults = the `py-md` / `px-lg` it always had) —
not a prop: a host that wants other margins wraps the viewer in a (sub-)theme
setting them, beside the type sizes it already sets there, so no file-viewer
host threads a renderer-specific option through `FileContent`.
